description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to handling backups, migration, and attachments for a note-taking application. It includes mechanisms for progress reporting, data migration, and attachment management, such as including files, keeping only metadata, or removing attachments.

classes.name: DefaultMigrationHandler
classes.description: A simple implementation of MigrationHandler that returns the input string unchanged.

classes.name: AttachmentHandler
classes.description: A sealed interface defining how attachments are handled during backup or migration processes.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Method in MigrationHandler interface; in DefaultMigrationHandler, it simply returns the deserialized string as-is.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Method in AttachmentHandler interface and its implementations; defines how to process an attachment during backup handling.
